about: Read by scripts/native-artifact-gate.py (D00 T05 §6). A publish folder's size is the sum of its files except the excluded patterns (program databases ship as a separate symbols archive) and the optional_content paths (relative glob patterns a release section names for content a user may leave out). An app's own budget goes under apps as {"<app>": {"mb": <n>, "decision": "<heading>", "publish": ["<folder>", ...]}}, and each budget needs a docs/dev/decisions.md entry whose **Budget:** line states the same number.
